claims.hypothesis: NGC 1313 has more clouds near virial equilibrium, possibly linked to its higher rate of massive cluster formation
claims.experiment: Plot sigma_v^2/R against surface density for dendrogram structures and compare to the alpha_vir = 1 line; compare alpha_vir distributions
claims.result: Both galaxies mostly above the virial line; NGC 1313 has larger scatter and more clouds close to virial equilibrium
claims.finding: NGC 1313 has more clouds near virial equilibrium, which may be connected to massive cluster formation

evidence.quote: NGC 1313 also has more clouds near virial equilibrium than NGC 7793, which may be connected to its higher rate of massive cluster formation.

claims.hypothesis: Virially bound clouds are more closely associated with young clusters than the general cloud population
claims.experiment: Gridded density-map correlations between young clusters and bound clouds versus all clouds over many cell sizes and alpha_vir thresholds
claims.result: Correlation with bound clouds (0.24 and 0.36) is not higher than with all clouds (0.32 and 0.44) in NGC 1313 and NGC 7793
claims.finding: Bound clouds do not show a stronger correlation with young clusters than the general cloud population

evidence.quote: In every case of cell size and $\alpha_\text{vir}$ threshold, the bound clouds are not more correlated with young clusters than the rest of the cloud population in either galaxy.

claims.hypothesis: Large differences in molecular cloud properties explain the large difference in massive cluster formation between the two galaxies
claims.experiment: Compare distributions of cloud mass, radius, linewidth, virial parameter, surface density, pressure and free-fall time using clumps, with bootstrapped KS and AD tests
claims.result: Differences are small; the largest are higher surface density and lower free-fall time in NGC 1313; only cluster mass distributions cross the 5% p-value threshold
claims.finding: Cloud properties differ surprisingly little, with NGC 1313 having higher surface densities and lower free-fall times

evidence.quote: We find surprisingly small differences between the distributions of molecular cloud populations in the two galaxies, though the largest of those differences are that NGC 1313 has higher surface densities and lower free-fall times.

claims.hypothesis: The molecular gas content differs between the galaxies despite NGC 1313 having more HI and more massive clusters
claims.experiment: Sum CO(2-1) emission in the footprint with average X_CO and factor 1.4, and compute the fraction of CO mass in clumps
claims.result: 7.6e6 Msun (NGC 1313) versus 1.4e7 Msun (NGC 7793); 82% versus 95% of CO mass in clumps
claims.finding: NGC 7793 has nearly twice the molecular mass in the footprint; NGC 1313 likely has more diffuse molecular gas

evidence.quote: We find that NGC 7793 contains nearly twice the molecular mass as NGC 1313

why_this_data.value: Observe both galaxies in CO(2-1) at matched 13 pc resolution and matched sensitivity so cloud properties can be compared without resolution or sensitivity effects

evidence.quote: To robustly compare the properties of the molecular clouds in this pair of galaxies, we have observed both in CO(2-1) with carefully matched spatial resolutions of 13 pc and surface brightness sensitivities of $\sim0.2$ K.

why_this_method.value: Dendrograms capture the hierarchy of gas from large GMCs to knots; non-overlapping clumps are needed for counting statistics

evidence.quote: Dendrograms are superior for examining the full spatial scale of molecular clouds in the region because they are able to capture the hierarchical nature of the gas, from large GMCs to smaller knots.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Alternative NGC 7793 metallicity gradient (Grasha22) tested; did not change results, so the lower Stanghellini15 metallicities were kept

evidence.quote: We find that the difference in metallicity prescription and resulting masses does not significantly affect any of the results in this paper

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Other fixed slopes for the size-linewidth fit tried; intercept values change but the conclusion does not

evidence.quote: Changing the fixed slope affects the values of the fitted intercepts, but not the conclusion that NGC 1313 has a significantly higher intercept and so more kinetic energy.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Embedded clusters of Messa21 in NGC 1313 not used because no equivalent catalog exists for NGC 7793

evidence.quote: However, since we do not also have embedded clusters identified in NGC 7793 to compare, we do not include those clusters in this work.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Keeping or removing age-degenerate clusters does not substantially change results

evidence.quote: We also note that there are few enough of these objects that keeping or removing them does not substantially alter our results.

limitations_admitted.value: Footprints are partial and 7m and total power data are not included, so diffuse emission and total molecular masses are missed

evidence.quote: It is important to note that our observations do not cover the whole galaxy and we do not include 7m and total power data, so we are likely missing diffuse emission

limitations_admitted.value: SFR ratio between galaxies is not statistically significant given counting statistics and 25% SFR uncertainty

evidence.quote: In this case, the ratios reported here are not statistically significant when considering error from counting statistics.

limitations_admitted.value: Bootstrapped KS and AD p-values do not necessarily indicate statistically significant differences and are used only to rank properties

evidence.quote: We recommend caution when interpreting the bootstrapped KS and AD tests

limitations_admitted.value: Missing flux at large scales may explain why cloud masses are smaller than the maximum cluster masses

evidence.quote: This observation could be in part caused by missing flux at the largest size scales since our observations do not include ACA 7m or TP data.

limitations_admitted.value: Clusters used may be too old to be associated with their natal molecular gas

evidence.quote: This may be because the clusters used in this study are too old to be associated with their natal molecular gas.

referee_caveats_inferred: Only two galaxies are compared, so morphology cannot be isolated from other differences (NGC 1313 has a minor interaction and a southwest starburst outside the footprint).

The two datasets were calibrated with different CASA and pipeline versions, calibrators and imaged with different robust values (0.5 vs 2.0); residual systematics after smoothing to 13 pc are not quantified.
Cloud masses depend on the Gong20 X_CO with metallicity assumptions (no gradient in NGC 1313), and X_CO varies by about a factor of 4 within each galaxy.
12m-only data lose diffuse emission and large-scale structure, which can bias linewidths, sizes and the molecular mass comparison.
The bootstrapped KS/AD p-values depend on the arbitrary subsample size (65) and the paper itself cautions against over-reading them.
The size-linewidth analysis fixes the slope at 0.5 and quotes only statistical intercept errors; dendrogram structures are nested so points are not independent.
Pipeline version is inconsistent between the Observations text and the Software section.

missing_for_reproduction: tclean imaging parameters (cell, imsize, deconvolver, threshold, masks, mosaic settings) and cube velocity range
noise estimation used for sigma-based thresholds in astrodendro and quickclump
exact definition and measurement of T_peak for the X_CO prescription
bootstrap subsample size and random seed; ODR fit setup
the specific LEGUS catalog files and the merged east/west cluster tables
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Roughly 100-300 GB of raw ASDMs/measurement sets for the two Band 6 12m mosaics (about 320 pointings in total), with final cubes of a few GB each (inferred).
reproducibility.score_reason: Score on a 1-5 scale. Project code, calibrators, pipeline/CASA versions, robust values, decomposition parameters and all formulas are given, but the tclean setup, cube definition, noise estimation and bootstrap details are missing and the pipeline version is inconsistent.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA project 2015.1.00782.S is given with archival-style acknowledgement, calibration and decomposition recipes are mostly specified, and main results (intercepts, cluster counts, masses, correlations) are numeric; imaging details must be chosen by the reproducer.
